note: Tier 1. Scry (701.22a) as an arrange answer, then cast_during_resolution (608.2g) without paying the mana cost (118.9): A activates Planetarium of Wan Shi Tong's "{1}, {T}: Scry 2.", keeps Lightning Bolt on top and puts a Forest on the bottom; the Planetarium's scry trigger lets A cast the top card, the Bolt, for free at B. The position is stipulated (spec 2.4), not reached by ordinary play.

transitions.note: Planetarium of Wan Shi Tong's first paragraph "{1}, {T}: Scry 2." is an activated ability (602.1) with no timing restriction; the Planetarium has been controlled since the turn began, though 302.6 concerns only creatures. 602.2a: the ability is created on the stack as S1, controlled by A (405.4), the first stack object that is not a card; it has no targets. 602.2b, 601.2g, 601.2h: the Mountain adds {R} (305.6), which pays {1}, and the Planetarium is tapped (a tier-2 fact, not stated). 117.3c: A receives priority and passes, B passes, and S1 resolves (117.4). 701.22a: A looks at the top two cards of A's library, Lightning Bolt and Forest; where to put them is the arrange question, asked with S1 still on the stack (spec 4.2).

701.22a: A puts the Forest on the bottom of A's library and the Bolt back on top; A's library is now, top first, Lightning Bolt, the second Forest, the first Forest. The reorder stays inside one zone, so it is written as zones.A.library.bottom (spec 4.1: top and bottom 'reorder without moving between zones (scry ...)'), not with 'at', which spec 4.1 reserves for a move into a library. 608.2n: S1 has finished resolving and ceases to exist. 701.22d, 603.2: the Planetarium's second paragraph "Whenever you scry or surveil, ..." triggers once the scry is complete; 603.3, 603.3a: A puts it on the stack the next time a player would receive priority, after S1 has left, as S2 (it has no targets or modes, and a single trigger needs no ordering, 603.3b). 117.3b: A receives priority; A and B pass (117.4) and S2 resolves: A looks at the top card of A's library, Lightning Bolt, and may cast it without paying its mana cost (608.2g, 118.9); 'You may' allows rather than instructs, so this question has a null answer (decline), but A is about to cast. S2 is still on the stack (spec 4.2).

608.2g: A casts Lightning Bolt from the top of A's library following 601.2a-i: it moves to the stack, above S2 (601.2a); 601.2b, 118.9: A announces the alternative cost 'without paying its mana cost' that S2 offers, so nothing is paid (118.9a: only this alternative cost applies); 601.2c: its target is B. 608.2g: no player receives priority after it is cast; S2 continues to resolve and, as its final part, ceases to exist (608.2n); the Bolt stays on the stack. 'Do this only once each turn' has now been used for this turn. 117.3b: the active player A receives priority; A and B pass (117.4) and the Bolt resolves: 608.2b, B is a legal target; 3 damage to B (120.3a): 17 life. 608.2n: the Bolt is put into A's graveyard. 704.3: no state-based action applies. 117.3b: A receives priority; the record ends there. A's library is now the second Forest above the first. The Bolt's cast fact ({cost: alternative, without_paying}) is not in the end state: the Bolt resolved within this stretch and is a new object in the graveyard (400.7, spec 4.1).
